english.note: This is the everyday all-purpose term for a small sticking plaster.
Use this for the adhesive-strip type of wound dressing rather than a bandage wrapped around the body.
Use this for an adhesive strip or plaster covering a wound rather than for a general repair patch.

examples.english: You’ve cut your finger; just put on a plaster.
examples.traditional: 你個手指損咗，貼塊膠布就得喇。

examples.english: My blister burst, so just put on a bandage and it’ll be fine.
examples.traditional: 我個水泡穿咗，貼塊膠布就得啦。
